facts.fact: Caleb 每周三去 Jeanine Matthews 的办公室替她处理她口中的「tedious work」，他自己几乎不觉得这活枯燥。
facts.anchor: Wednesday is the day that he goes to Jeanine Matthews’s office

facts.fact: 他给笔记按颜色分类：蓝为 Erudite 事务、红为城市事务、绿为短期价值实验、紫为长期价值实验，且还在不断加新标签。
facts.anchor: Blue for Erudite business, red for city business, green for experiments with short-term value, purple for experiments with long-term value

facts.fact: 一天结束后她进紧挨实验室的私人图书室泡茶；窗边种着花和香草，叶子由她自己晒干，然后请他坐下陪她。
facts.anchor: she grows flowers and herbs along the windows, and dries the leaves herself in the sun

facts.fact: 母亲要他把近几年的倾向测试结果与 Erudite 转派人数作比较，消息由妹妹转达，他没有做。
facts.anchor: She asked me to compare the aptitude test results from the past few years to the number of Erudite faction transfers

facts.fact: Jeanine 说不怪他：对家庭的忠诚很难一下摆脱，派别高于血缘只是口号；她叫他坐下，并说这场谈话会很难，但不是他以为的那种难。
facts.anchor: a mantra is not a reality

facts.fact: Jeanine 认为 Natalie 劝女儿脱离 Abnegation 去当无派系者，动机不是为 Beatrice 好，而是要有人替她盯着那边。
facts.anchor: she’s the one who encouraged your sister to defect from Abnegation and become factionless

facts.fact: Jeanine 指 Natalie 还参与掩盖从 Abnegation 浮出的最令人不安的报告，也就是 Dauntless 墙卫从 Memory Vault 出来后失忆那些。
facts.anchor: She has also been complicit in covering up the most troubling reports that have surfaced from Abnegation

facts.fact: 末了她盯着他，说任何单一群体握有这种控制都过头，并问他是否也这么想。
facts.anchor: too much control for any one group to have
